## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at 7 Calle de Sánchez Bustillo.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> IKONO is a visual, eye-popping paradise for anyone looking to spice up their social feeds. This 60-minute adventure whizzes you through a colorful array of rooms, each with their own unique and exciting experience inside.
>
> Smells, colours, objects that require your touch – your senses will be sent into overdrive as you explore, snapping photos to make your phone's screen pop!

## Where this page comes from
